prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, redesign] Story scroll layout for home intro screen: Rebuild the final home intro screen with a story scroll layout that presents onboarding completion steps sequentially.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Welcome to your new desktop companion", "body": "Scroll down to see basic shortcuts and get started."}}
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop sound check screen before waiting: Add a new screen named new_sound_check before waiting to let users adjust and test pet audio alerts before generation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_sound_check", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_sound_check": {"headline": "Test Desktop Audio", "body": "Listen to sample sound cues and set your preferred companion volume."}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Companion trait choice sub-flow on pick friend screen: Add an interactive trait selection choice cards component to the pick friend screen to customize pet temperament.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Select pet personality trait", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign in screen before path selection: Reorder sign_in to appear immediately after the story screen and before path selection.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "sign_in", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [choose_path, hint] Path customization hint on choose path screen: Add a helpful hint text to the choose_path screen clarifying that path selection can be changed in settings later.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "You can modify your path and pet settings anytime from the desktop menu."}}
5: [sign_in, layout] Account sync focus layout on sign in screen: Switch sign_in to a centered layout emphasizing account synchronization.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Sync Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Sign in to bind your pet to your account and keep progress safe across reinstalls."}}
6: [adoption, wait_info] Generation time estimate on upload photos screen: Enable generation time estimate and readiness notification fields on the photo upload screen.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Processing uploaded photos usually takes under 1 minute."}}
7: [home, wait_info] Mascot progress status on waiting screen: Add a pet mascot graphic and progress indicator component to the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:pet_builder", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "progress", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [finish, copy] Desktop control shortcut guide on home intro: Update copy on home_intro screen to clearly outline desktop shortcuts for hiding and controlling the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is Ready", "body": "Click your desktop pet to interact, or right-click to hide or open settings."}}
9: [adoption, redesign] Stage layout redesign for photo upload screen: Redesign the upload_photos screen layout to stage view to focus user focus on pet photo selection.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Upload High Quality Pet Photos", "body": "Clear front-facing photos produce the best desktop pet results."}}
